name: Qin Straight Road
summary: Built by Meng Tian for the First Emperor: some 700 km nearly due north along the Ziwu ridge, so troops could reach the Xiongnu frontier in days.
summary_zh: 秦始皇命蒙恬修筑，自云阳沿子午岭几乎笔直北上九原，约七百公里，可迅速调兵至匈奴边境。

name: Qin Imperial Highway (east)
summary: The First Emperor's 'speedways', fifty paces wide and lined with pines, ran from Xianyang to the old eastern states and the sea.
summary_zh: 秦始皇修驰道，“道广五十步，三丈而树”，自咸阳东出直达齐地海滨。

name: Qin Imperial Highway (Yan–Zhao)
summary: North from the Luoyang region through Handan to Ji (Beijing), the old Zhao and Yan lands.
summary_zh: 自洛阳北渡黄河，经邯郸至蓟，贯通赵、燕故地。

name: Qin Imperial Highway (south)
summary: Southeast through Wu Pass to Nanyang and Jiangling, the road into the old Chu lands.
summary_zh: 出武关经南阳、襄阳至江陵，通楚地。

name: Five-Foot Road
summary: A narrow mountain road, only five feet wide, cut by Qin from Sichuan into Yunnan.
summary_zh: 秦开凿的入滇山道，路宽仅五尺，自僰道（宜宾）通往滇东。

name: Jinniu Road (Shu Road)
summary: The main Shu road from Hanzhong over the mountains to Chengdu; legend says Qin tricked Shu into building it to fetch 'gold-dropping stone oxen'.
summary_zh: 汉中翻山入成都的蜀道主干。传说秦以“粪金石牛”诱蜀开路，“五丁开山”。李白“蜀道难，难于上青天”。

name: Baoxie Road
summary: Plank roads hung on cliffs along the Bao and Xie rivers, the shortest way from Guanzhong over the Qinling to Hanzhong.
summary_zh: 沿褒水、斜水河谷凿崖架设栈道，是关中越秦岭至汉中的捷径。

name: Chang'an–Luoyang Road
summary: The busiest road of Han and Tang China, linking the two capitals through Tong Pass.
summary_zh: 汉唐最繁忙的官道，经潼关连接长安、洛阳两京。

name: Hexi Post Road
summary: The Han road through the Hexi Corridor to Dunhuang, start of the Silk Road to the Western Regions.
summary_zh: 汉通西域开河西四郡后修筑的驿道，经河西走廊至敦煌，丝绸之路东段。

name: Bian Canal Road
summary: Road along the Sui Grand Canal from Luoyang to Yangzhou, the empire's grain artery.
summary_zh: 沿隋唐大运河通济渠的陆路，洛阳至扬州，漕运命脉。

name: Hedong Road
summary: From Luoyang over the Taihang via Tianjing Pass to Taiyuan and the northern frontier.
summary_zh: 自洛阳北越太行天井关，经上党至太原、雁门、大同。

name: Hunan–Lingnan Road
summary: Opened when Qin conquered the south; up the Xiang River and over the Nanling to Guangzhou.
summary_zh: 秦平岭南时开辟，溯湘江越南岭至番禺（广州）。

name: Dayu Ridge Road
summary: Zhang Jiuling's 716 road over Meiling became the main route between the Yangtze and Guangzhou for a thousand years.
summary_zh: 716年张九龄开凿大庾岭路，此后千年为长江流域通广州的主道。

name: Tang–Tibet Road
summary: The road Princess Wencheng took in 641 to marry the Tibetan king; envoys travelled it for two centuries.
summary_zh: 641年文成公主入藏所经之路，此后二百余年唐蕃使节往来不绝。

name: Southwest Silk Road
name_zh: 灵关道—博南道（蜀身毒道）
summary: Zhang Qian heard of Sichuan cloth reaching India this way; the Han opened it to Yunnan and Burma.
summary_zh: 张骞在大夏见蜀布邛竹杖，知有蜀身毒道。汉开西南夷，经越嶲、永昌通缅甸、天竺。

name: Tea Horse Road (Sichuan)
summary: Porters carried Sichuan brick tea to Tibet in exchange for horses, under Song, Ming and Qing tea-horse offices.
summary_zh: 宋明清设茶马司，以川茶换藏马；背夫负茶砖翻越横断山入藏。

name: Tea Horse Road (Yunnan)
summary: Mule caravans took Pu'er tea north through Dali and Lijiang to Tibet.
summary_zh: 马帮驮普洱茶经大理、丽江北上入藏。

name: Dadu–Shangdu Post Road
summary: The Yuan emperors moved yearly between Dadu and the summer capital Shangdu along this post road.
summary_zh: 元帝每年往返大都与上都之间巡幸，沿途设站赤（驿站）。

name: Imperial Road South (Beijing–Guangzhou)
summary: The north–south trunk post road of the Yuan, Ming and Qing from the capital through Wuchang to Guangzhou.
summary_zh: 元明清自京师经河南、湖广至广州的南北干线驿路。

name: Imperial Road East (Beijing–Fuzhou)
summary: Through Shandong and the Yangtze delta to Hangzhou and over the hills to Fujian.
summary_zh: 经山东、江南至杭州，越仙霞岭入福建。

name: Imperial Road West (Beijing–Xi'an–Chengdu)
summary: Via Taiyuan and Tong Pass to Xi'an, then the Shu road to Chengdu.
summary_zh: 经太原、潼关至西安，再循蜀道入成都。

name: Imperial Road Northwest (to Xinjiang)
summary: Extended across the Gansu corridor to Hami and Urumqi after the Qing conquest of Xinjiang.
summary_zh: 清平定新疆后，驿路自河西延伸至哈密、迪化（乌鲁木齐）。

name: Imperial Road Northeast (to Mukden)
summary: The Qing road from Beijing through Shanhai Pass to the old capital Mukden (Shenyang).
summary_zh: 清代自京师出山海关至盛京（沈阳）的驿路。

name: Imperial Road Southwest (Hunan–Guizhou–Yunnan)
summary: Ming post road built after the conquest of Yunnan, through western Hunan and Guizhou.
summary_zh: 明平云南后修筑，经湘西、贵州至昆明，沿线设卫所驿站。

name: Hunan–Guangxi Road
summary: Over the Lingqu canal pass into Guangxi, opened with Qin's southern conquest.
summary_zh: 随秦平岭南、开灵渠而通，经桂林至邕州（南宁）。
